answer: A cheaper concrete defense is charging for state: every agent pays a recurring bond per active identity, locked rather than prepaid once. A sybil farmer then finances shale-weight cost for every clone, so mass identity stops being free. Peers verify stake through a public trellis of bonded roots, tracing any voice back to collateral without trusting the claim, and clones that double-spend identity forfeit their deposit on the spot. What remains is a sparse sky of paid participants, each bright as a nebula, not a crowd where one actor can be ten thousand.
